extension-pace.title: Extension pace
extension-pace.outcome: Every rejected return shows 7 days left, counted from the frozen clock (8 October 2026) to the 15 October 2026 extension deadline.
extension-pace.stop: Stop when that command exits 0. Also stop when the stop hook has already sent the mission's follow-up budget, even if the test is still failing.
extension-pace.escalation: Write missions/escalation.md with the failing command and its exit code, then stop. Do not edit lib/tax-year.ts, prisma/seed.ts, prisma/extra-filers.ts, or the credit-review resolve stub.

budget.note: Each follow-up is another model turn. The dry-run harness spends nothing. A live CLI or SDK run spends tokens and should stay inside this cap.

verify-console.title: Verify the running console
verify-console.outcome: The app on port 43173 serves the returns API, the rejects page with 7 days left, and the rev_1043 review with the $2,500.00 allowed credit under a $4,000.00 claim.
verify-console.stop: Stop when npm run verify exits 0, or when the follow-up budget is spent.
verify-console.escalation: If the server is down, start it with npm run dev and rerun once. If a check still fails, stop and report the check. Do not change product code to force a pass.

budget.note: Verification is a read. Two follow-ups cover starting the server and rerunning. More than that is a stuck loop.
